merchant/30003.htm.text: Accessory Merchant Silvia: Hey there! If you see something you like, buy it quickly. I don't have time to waste sitting here all day, despite what my aunt thinks. A pretty girl like me deserves to have some fun, you know!

merchant/30003-pk.htm.text: Accessory Merchant Silvia: How rude. That someone like you should dare to come to my shop! I suggest you go away before all men of the village gather and punish you.

Q00153_DeliverGoods/30003-02.html.text: Trader Silvia: Go and show the receipt I gave you to Guard Arnold. And please tell him thank you, I have received the goods in good condition.
